wins: Completed full reconnaissance sweep within time budget, yielding clear port and service inventory for the target.
Consistently gathered high-confidence attack surface data, enabling informed follow-up actions despite no final success.
Mentor calls were effectively used to validate decision points before executing potentially noisy actions.
fails: Unable to achieve mission success despite full reconnaissance; exploration stopped before critical exploitation phase could complete.
No successful post-exploitation was recorded, indicating a gap in privilege escalation preparation or execution.
High number of mentor calls (15) suggests repeated uncertainty in action selection and limited automation confidence.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase executed reliably, but follow-up exploitation and escalation capability need targeted improvement to convert data into mission success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts consistently aborted after identifying outdated service banners, preventing payload deployment.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 443 responds with a valid SSL/TLS handshake
skill_cards.then_action: Run ssl-enum-ciphers and check for weak suites before launching web-specific exploits

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service returns a custom header indicating outdated software
skill_cards.then_action: Capture the banner and match against known CVEs, then prioritize exploit chaining

skill_cards.if_condition: When Nmap scan reveals open SMB ports with anonymous login allowed
skill_cards.then_action: Enumerate shares and run smb-os-discovery scripts before considering lateral movement

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in early SSL-based reconnaissance and strong signal for prioritizing safe certificate enumeration.
Reliable SMB enumeration provided concrete next steps for exploitation pipeline.

next_experiments.title: Exploit chaining for outdated HTTP component
next_experiments.description: Use identified outdated HTTP server header to match specific CVEs, then craft a targeted exploit to progress into exploitation phase.

next_experiments.title: Privilege escalation follow-up
next_experiments.description: After capturing banner data, attempt controlled privilege escalation using vetted modules for the detected services and maintain logging for failure points.

next_experiments.title: Streamlined decision policy
next_experiments.description: Reduce mentor calls by codifying decision criteria from successful reconnaissance steps into quicker heuristics for action selection.
